Note that in this case a 5xx means an actual 5xx respond code, or an event that would cause the HTTP router to return one on the upstream’s behalf(reset, connection failure, etc.) consecutive_5xx indicates the number of consecutive 5xx

If an upstream endpoint returns some number of consecutive “gateway errors” (502, 503 or 504 status code), it will be ejected. Note that this includes events that would cause the HTTP router to return one of these status codes on the upstream’s behalf (reset, connection failure, etc.). Consecutive_gateway_failure
